task.prompt:
Implement the PostgreSQL stored procedure named sp with the exact signature:
sp(para_production_type_code text, para_parent_product_id integer, para_town_city text, para_login_name text)

The procedure updates matching rows in the relevant tables according to the supplied parameter values. It raises an exception when matching rows are absent where required.

Use the attached template.sql and the attached slot dictionary slots.md. Fill in every {SLOT_n} placeholder in template.sql exactly as specified by its corresponding entry in slots.md. The slot dictionary defines every slot; use it as the only source for what each slot must contain.

Do not add, remove, or reorder any statement. Leave all code outside the slots exactly as it is.

Return the complete stored procedure, and nothing else.
